note: 27 numbered primitive sites in six small camps spread over the area, each with a fire ring and lantern post and nothing else. This pin is sites 25-27 on the open point at 48-acre Bennitt Lake, the only camp closed to horses, with a privy, boat ramp and fishing dock close by. Sites 1-24 are shared with horse campers and have hitching posts; the largest group, sites 6-16, is a gravel loop off County Road 2920 on the west side. Camping along roads and in parking lots is allowed only in firearms deer season. --Claude
summary: Confirmed as real designated camping: 27 numbered sites in six mapped camps (brochure, map, six GIS points). Pin is on the Bennitt Lake camp (sites 25-27, horse-free). Privy written. PHONE MISMATCH flagged. Waterfront lead UP from not waterfront to lakeview. Split proposal: the 11-site loop (sites 6-16) 1.95 km away on its own road.
flags: PHONE MISMATCH (apply.py does not write it): stored 573-815-7900; the area page says 'For more information call (573) 445-3882'.

INCLUSION (stays; designated numbered sites): brochure: 'Twenty seven (27) numbered sites are available for both equestrian and general camping throughout the area (Horses are prohibited at sites 25-27). No reservations taken for campsites. Hitching posts, lantern posts and fire rings provided. No other amenities are provided. Camping along roads and in parking lots is only allowed during firearms deer season. Walk-in and backpack camping is permitted year-round.' The map labels six camps: Sites 1-5 (east, County Road 2930, GIS 39.26459,-92.44068), Sites 6-16 (west, County Road 2920, GIS 39.26334,-92.46996), Sites 17-18 (39.25926,-92.46161), Sites 19-21 (39.25001,-92.46488), Sites 22-24 (Boy Scout lot, 39.24736,-92.44206) and Sites 25-27 at Bennitt Lake (39.24736,-92.46069 = the stored pin). HORSE RULE: no camp is a horse-only camp; sites 1-24 are shared equestrian/general with hitching posts, sites 25-27 are horse-free. The pinned camp is the horse-free one, so the entry is not a horse camp. Site lengths are not published.

WATERFRONT LEAD UP (stored not waterfront, no stored evidence): the pinned camp is on an open mown point on Bennitt Lake. The GIS point is on open grass about 15 m off the entry road with roughly 70 m of open grass down to the north cove; a small lot at 39.24795,-92.45948 has two short gravel spurs 10-25 m from the water; the ramp lot and its drive are to the east. I could not see fire rings on the frame, so I cannot say which of those spots are sites 25-27. The lake is in open view from the point either way: supports at least LAKEVIEW. Lakefront would need the three sites located (if they are the spurs by the north lot they are within 25 m on open ground); unsure, so the lower call: lakeview.

SPLIT PROPOSAL: Sites 6-16 at 39.26334,-92.46996 is a built oval gravel loop about 130 m long in a clearing, reached by County Road 2920 on the west side - 1.95 km from the pin, own road, eleven sites (more than this pin's three). No existing campgrounds.json entry within 3.5 km other than 13753. Caveat for the owner: these are shared equestrian/general sites with hitching posts (not a horse-only camp, but horse campers use them). Not waterfront (upland clearing). A second possible one is Sites 1-5 at 39.26459,-92.44068 (2.6 km from the pin, County Road 2930, under canopy beside the Slab Parking Lot) - smaller, five sites. Sites 17-18, 19-21 and 22-24 are two or three sites each.
PIN: stored 39.24736,-92.46069 is the GIS point of the lake camp. No move (unless the owner would rather the entry stand for the 11-site loop).
FACILITIES: privy, concrete boat ramp, fishing dock and ADA parking are mapped at Bennitt Lake beside sites 25-27; vault_toilets written for this camp. The other camps have none.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) stands; nothing dates the designated sites.
